import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0018 (a b c : ℝ) (h_a_pos : a > 0) (h_discr_neg : b^2 - 4 * a * c < 0) : ∀ x : ℝ, a * x^2 + b * x + c > 0 := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0018 (a b c : ℝ) (h_a_pos : a > 0) (h_discr_neg : b^2 - 4 * a * c < 0) : ∀ x : ℝ, a * x^2 + b * x + c > 0 := by
  intro x
  have h1 : a * x^2 + b * x + c = a * (x + b / (2 * a))^2 + c - b^2 / (4 * a) := by
    rw [mul_add, add_assoc, mul_div_cancel_left (ne_of_gt h_a_pos)]
  have h2 : a * (x + b / (2 * a))^2 ≥ 0 := by
    rw [h1]
    apply mul_nonneg
    exact h_a_pos
    apply sq_nonneg
  have h3 : c - b^2 / (4 * a) > 0 := by
    rw [h1]
    linarith [h_discr_neg, h_a_pos]
  exact add_pos h2 h3
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0018 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0018 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
